GROUND HANDLING AGREEMENT

1. SERVICE LEVELS
The Ground Handler shall operate ramp services and maintain turnaround availability of 98 percent monthly.

2. OPERATIONAL REPORTING
The Ground Handler shall report service failures within 2 hours after grounding.

3. SERVICE PENALTIES
The Ground Handler shall pay liquidated damages of EUR 100,000 following a service failure.

4. INDEMNITY
The Ground Handler indemnifies the Airline for all losses arising from ground damage.

5. SAFETY COMPLIANCE
The Ground Handler shall comply with airport safety requirements quarterly.

6. TERMINATION
The Airline may terminate following an uncured operational default after 10 days.
